===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Amlogic]] [https://www.cnx-software.com/2019/02/01/amlogic-s922x-benchmarks/ S922X] (ARMv8-A 64-bit) :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A73) @1.8GHz :+ Dual-core ARM (Cortex-A53) @1.9GHz *GPU: ''Mali-G52 MP4'' @800MHz (AFBC, DX12, :OpenGL ES3.2, OpenVG1.1, OpenCL 2.0) *Storage: 64GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, :TF card (max.256GB)/MMC Card slot *RAM: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[SparkLAN AP6275S]] • [[Broadcom]] BCM43752 (2T2R) :SDIO 3.0: Wi-Fi 802.11abgn/ac/ax, UART/PCM: BT 5.0 LE *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 2x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 2A via barrel
